svg.title: How the 105 starts ended
svg.desc: 21 circuits × 5 starts per controller. Clean, Contact, Collision, Timeout. Edited PPO — 83, 5, 17, 0. Previous arc — 93, 0, 0, 12. Speed only — 93, 0, 0, 12. Nose guard — 95, 0, 0, 10. Contact = body touched or overlapped a wall in a saved pose.
